githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.5 Beta 6 adds native soundboard support and redesigns the sidebar profile and voice controls. It also improves voice connection recovery, profile presentation, interface polish, and Nightly update selection.

## Soundboard

- Added Soundboard access to the sidebar and in-call voice controls, with searchable Favorites, Frequently Used, Discord Sounds, and per-server collections.
- Added permission-aware voice-channel playback, local previews, favoriting, sound downloads, and sound ID copying.
- Added playback for incoming soundboard effects, active playback feedback, and animated sound emoji over participants in voice calls.
- Improved repeated sound playback so retriggering a sound interrupts the previous copy instead of allowing them to overlap.

## Voice controls and reliability

- Redesigned the sidebar voice panel to show connection state, channel and server, call duration, and direct controls for screen sharing, camera, mute, deafen, and disconnect.
- Improved the in-call control dock with responsive labeled and compact layouts, clearer active states, and split controls for media devices and options.
- Fixed a reconnect loop after Discord displaced an existing voice session and improved recovery from voice gateway closures and server migrations.
- Added timeouts and retries to voice UDP setup and address discovery so failed connections no longer remain stuck indefinitely.
- Expanded voice lifecycle and transport diagnostics to make connection failures easier to investigate.

## You Bar and profiles

- Redesigned the sidebar account area as a profile-focused You Bar with decorated avatars, presence, nameplate effects, and a dedicated Settings button.
- Added a full profile popover containing presence selection, saved-account switching, and account management.
- Prefetched the current user’s profile when entering a server so the You Bar can open directly to the completed profile card.
- Adapted themed profile cards to light mode and unified presence indicator rendering throughout the app.

## Interface and updates

- Made fresh Nightly installations select the Nightly update feed by default while preserving an existing user-selected track.
- Refined supplementary conversation toolbar alignment and kept pinned-message and thread panels from competing for the same space.
- Fixed the About settings background tint and improved several smaller toolbar and popover interactions.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.5-Beta-5...v0.1.5-Beta-6](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.5-Beta-5...v0.1.5-Beta-6)
discordAnnouncement:
**Native soundboard, voice controls, and a new You Bar 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Play, preview, search, favorite, and download sounds from Discord and your servers
- Soundboard emoji effects now animate over participants in voice calls, while repeated sounds no longer overlap
- Redesigned sidebar and in-call voice controls show connection status, call duration, media controls, and Soundboard
- The new You Bar opens your full profile and keeps status and account switching close at hand
- Voice recovery now handles displaced sessions, server migrations, and stalled UDP setup more reliably
- Fresh Nightly installations now stay on the Nightly update feed by default
